trigger: A local user symlinks ~/Library at a hung mount they control (an unprivileged smbfs mount in their own directory); the root agent's lstat follows it and pins a shared command-pool worker, and the textual mount guard cannot see it. A dangling link also read absent (security-guardian SG-2).
classification_rationale: no open-first guard: lstat follows intermediate symlinks
summary: Fixed in 74e4fbeb7 (open first with O_NOFOLLOW_ANY, ELOOP refuses without traversing; dangling link reads unreadable open_failed:symlink) and 251fe96e8 (parent directory pinned, database and sidecars named relative to it). Tests: dangling-symlink case; mutant lstat-first killed.

adjudicated_by: unhappy-path and security-guardian (governance agents, independent probes: a disk image mounted under /Users lists as its own path); not the change's author. De-escalation of the reporter's floor claim, not of the fix obligation.
adjudication_rationale: The mount table lists a user-made mount under the path it was made at, so the guard works for those; only system-created firmlinked mounts need the prefix form, which is fixed. The clause is therefore met once the prefix branch lands.
trigger: An autofs (or other system-created) mount on the firmlinked volume is listed as /System/Volumes/Data/<path>, which never prefixes /Users/... or /home/... paths.
classification_rationale: routed clause 5 says a network-mounted path is never touched; system-created firmlinked mounts are listed with a /System/Volumes/Data prefix the matcher did not handle
summary: Reporter claimed the guard was dead for every path under /Users. Refuted for user-made mounts: an APFS image mounted under a home lists as its own path (probe by unhappy-path and security-guardian). Fixed for system-created mounts in 74e4fbeb7: the matcher also tries the path with the /System/Volumes/Data prefix stripped; tests use the captured shapes.

trigger: A user-run macFUSE/sshfs mount serving a home whose server is down hangs lstat/open with no deadline (also raised by sre S1 and cross-platform).
classification_rationale: macfuse/osxfuse are not in the shared or local deny-list
summary: Fixed in 74e4fbeb7: macfuse and osxfuse added to is_network_mount_fstype, with tests.

trigger: A /Users entry renamed or removed between readdir and fstatat is missed under both names.
classification_rationale: ENOENT at fstatat was skipped with no row, so a renamed home could vanish from an OK/FULL run
summary: Fixed in 74e4fbeb7: a named <user>:home_vanished unreadable row. Untested (needs a fstatat seam): disclosed and tracked in #5119.

trigger: sqlite3_column_text returns NULL for both a NULL column and OOM; only the db owner (whose rows are already disclosed as non-attesting) can plant NULs (also cpp-safety N3).
classification_rationale: client ? client : "-" cannot tell a NULL column from an out-of-memory result, and column_bytes was ignored so an embedded NUL truncated the client
summary: Fixed in 74e4fbeb7: column_type distinguishes NULL from OOM (step_failed), the value is read by length, NUL becomes '?'. Tests kill the truncate-at-NUL and NULL-check mutants.

trigger: bad_alloc while charging rows calls std::terminate and skips the plugin's catch(...) containment (also plugin-developer F1, unhappy-path UP-2).
classification_rationale: OutputBudget::charge is noexcept but calls the allocating format_row
summary: Fixed in 74e4fbeb7: noexcept removed; a static_assert pin was added in 251fe96e8.

trigger: The owner edits a page through a shared writable mapping mid-read and restores it; mtime, ctime and size do not move until munmap.
classification_rationale: the FileStamp comment and routed clause claim a mid-read change is always refused; an owner holding a MAP_SHARED mapping is not detected
summary: Wording fixed in 74e4fbeb7/251fe96e8 (README caveat 3, FileStamp comment, banner, routed row). The owner authors every row anyway. Root-cause alternative (in-memory copy via sqlite3_deserialize) tracked in #5118.

trigger: A view over a recursive CTE with ORDER BY inside a <= 4 MiB file spills ~44 MB of temp data / ~130 MB RSS within the 500 ms source budget.
classification_rationale: the Resource Ledger said no temp paths in production code; a hostile view can make SQLite spill temp data under $TMPDIR
summary: Bounded by the source and run budgets; disclosed in README caveat 3 and the banner. Disabling views and triggers (which would also remove the class) would gut the hostile-view tests, so it is tracked in #5116.

trigger: A view or a home directory named to contain ',' forges an extra token in the comma-joined provenance logged by the agent (also consistency-auditor F6).
classification_rationale: sqlite_errmsg claimed delimiter-free text but kept ','; home names entered provenance tokens unscrubbed
summary: Fixed in 74e4fbeb7: ',' folded in sqlite_errmsg; token_safe() applied to every home name in a token; U+2028/2029 folded in 251fe96e8.

trigger: A hard link to a root-readable, TCC-shaped database inside a home would be read as that user's rows (bounded by the not_sqlite header gate and the fixed query).
classification_rationale: no st_nlink==1 or file-owner==home-owner check on the database
summary: Defence in depth, not a live defect; tracked in #5118.

trigger: Dropping the NULL auth_value check or the step-failure mapping left every test green.
classification_rationale: no macOS test observed a NULL auth_value or a failing step end to end
summary: Fixed in 74e4fbeb7: NULL/step-error/NUL/dangling-symlink/fd-leak tests; the mutants are now killed.

trigger: Changing open_readonly(/dev/fd/N) to the path left the test green; the test only proves unlink moves ctime.
classification_rationale: the test comment claimed to prove descriptor binding it cannot observe
summary: Fixed in 74e4fbeb7: test and comment reworded to what it observes (changed_during_read, replacement never parsed). Not cited as closure evidence for any blocking finding, so no floor.

trigger: Removing the deadline.fired->timeout mapping survived on a slow host; removing the progress handler hung the suite.
classification_rationale: the 20 ms wall-clock test passes on both timeout paths, so the mid-step mapping is covered only by luck
summary: Fixed in 74e4fbeb7: a deterministic mid-step timeout test (poke() expires the deadline from inside the running query, finite CTE so a regression ends rather than hangs).

trigger: A leaked dup per source left all tests green.
classification_rationale: no test counted descriptors across the cleanup paths
summary: Fixed in 74e4fbeb7; warm-up baseline added in 251fe96e8.

trigger: CI's non-admin user is expected uid 501+ but unmeasured; nothing surfaces a skip count.
classification_rationale: three tests skip below uid 500 (hard-coded constant); several constants and pragmas have surviving mutants
summary: Tracked with the fault-injection seams in #5119.

trigger: instruction-file-standard: net growth over ~500 chars needs an extraction; the absolute wording contradicts the disclosed residuals (also docs-writer F2).
classification_rationale: clause 5 grew the always-loaded row by +525 chars with mechanism prose and over-claimed 'refused before any syscall touches it'
summary: Fixed in 74e4fbeb7/251fe96e8: clause 5 rewritten as invariant plus pointer, qualified by the run-start mount table; the trailing sentence deleted; row growth +349 chars.

trigger: autoruns_macos.cpp's rule has already diverged; a third consumer (browser_inventory) is coming.
classification_rationale: the /Users home rule, the mount snapshot and the macOS fstype names are second copies that can drift
summary: Keep local now; share when a macOS runtimes/filesystem_posture guard lands. Tracked in #5117.

trigger: A works-council or DSAR reader over-reads Linux exposure (also consistency-auditor F1).
classification_rationale: row 542 said Linux portal rows are qualified with the profile/home name; only macOS and Windows qualify
summary: Fixed in 74e4fbeb7.

trigger: An auditor treats a per-user row as what tccd enforces (MDM precedence is not modelled).
classification_rationale: row 542 presents macOS per-user rows as the enforced state; they report what the user's own writable TCC.db records
summary: Fixed in 74e4fbeb7: clause added to row 542; README caveat 3 already stated it.

refuted_by: format_row -> safe_output_field maps '\\' to '/' (privacy_permissions_parsers.hpp, sdk string_utils.hpp); tests/unit/test_privacy_permissions_macos_internals.cpp asserts format_row(...) == "permissions|macos|evil/a.app|camera|denied|0|-|-"
refuted_by_reporter: happy-path (governance agent; independent trace of format_row and the sample); not the change's author
trigger: An operator parses the sample.
classification_rationale: reporter claimed the code emits a backslash qualifier while the sample/README show a slash
summary: Refuted: qualify_app_id builds '<user>\\<client>' internally, but format_row runs the app_id through safe_output_field, which folds backslash to '/' on the wire; the existing internals test asserts the wire row 'permissions|macos|evil/a.app|camera|denied|0|-|-'. happy-path independently traced format_row. The sample is correct.

trigger: A changed meaning of an auth_value would not fail visibly.
classification_rationale: 'schema proven on macOS 26.6.2 only' and auth_value 3 (limited) -> allowed appeared only in a code comment
summary: Fixed in 74e4fbeb7: README states both.

trigger: MCP discovery, the capability matrix and the UI show the descriptor/yaml text (also plugin-developer F2/F3).
classification_rationale: descriptor fallback and yaml description omitted: per-user rows do not attest tccd, homes outside /Users or on network mounts are not read; mechanism said 'never read' for a changing file that is read then discarded
summary: Fixed in 74e4fbeb7: descriptor mechanism/fallback and yaml updated; leg-hash 9b1bec4e5ba4; matrix, samples, README, JSON regenerated.

trigger: A security questionnaire asks what widening the grant implies.
classification_rationale: no doc says the Full Disk Access grant is agent-wide or how a pilot operator proceeds
summary: Fixed in 74e4fbeb7: darwin-compat row, privilege-model clause, README caveat 2.

trigger: An operator reading 0.14.0 -> next release notes.
classification_rationale: fragment did not say it replaces the released placeholder, that the plugin stays default-off, or that the production identity is unmeasured
summary: Fixed in 74e4fbeb7.

trigger: A pinned worker shows only a RUNNING command.
classification_rationale: caveat 3 stated the residual but not how to diagnose or recover
summary: Fixed in 74e4fbeb7: sample <agent pid> and restart; the recovery claim qualified as unmeasured in 251fe96e8.

trigger: A Mac with very many homes and no Full Disk Access.
classification_rationale: result provenance is comma-joined, uncapped and logged; per-home tokens make it scale to ~120 KB with 4096 denied homes
summary: Host-side, already tracked: comment with evidence added to #4976 (unescaped and unbounded plugin provenance). The plugin-side name scrubbing landed in the fix rounds.

trigger: Homes are read in sorted-name order, so an early-named hostile account can starve later ones.
classification_rationale: about 20 hostile slow homes exhaust the 10 s run budget; later homes read timeout
summary: Rejected as the designed, documented bound: later sources get a named timeout row (not silence) and README says a timeout on later sources means the run budget was spent, retry. Fairness across homes is not a stated requirement.

refuted_by: cross-platform probe (launchd job without Full Disk Access): open() on the system db, a per-user db and the com.apple.TCC directory returns EPERM while lstat succeeds; both sources classify denied with token open_failed:errno_1
refuted_by_reporter: cross-platform (governance agent, independent real non-FDA run); not the change's author
trigger: No trigger was named: the descriptor is already authorised at open(2).
classification_rationale: a TCC refusal surfacing at read/step time as IOERR+EPERM would read unreadable, not denied
summary: Refuted by cross-platform's probe as a non-FDA launchd job: the refusal occurs at open(2) (EPERM), and reads on an already-open descriptor are not re-checked; both sources classified denied.

trigger: A metadata write during the read.
classification_rationale: ctime moves on metadata-only changes such as xattr writes
summary: Rejected: conservative refusal in the safe direction with documented retry guidance; the alternative (dropping ctime) reopens the mtime-restore bypass.

trigger: A run with one refused and one failed source.
classification_rationale: PERMISSION_DENIED wins over CONSTRAINED when both occur
summary: Rejected: select_status precedence is the shared, documented contract for every leg; other tokens still appear in the provenance string.

trigger: A source at its deadline during the pragma exec.
classification_rationale: the time bound has 1000-opcode granularity and the pragma exec can be mislabelled query_only_failed:interrupted
summary: Rejected: cosmetic label only; the bound still holds.

trigger: Two rows with the same client and different auth_value.
classification_rationale: ties between equal clients followed scan order
summary: Fixed in 74e4fbeb7: tie-break on auth_value; test added.

trigger: Style drift.
classification_rationale: lines over the 100-column clang-format limit (CI format job is disabled)
summary: Rewrapped the lines this change introduced in 74e4fbeb7/251fe96e8; pre-existing salvage lines left as they were.

trigger: Reader confusion (also docs-writer F7).
classification_rationale: a stale -Wunused-function pragma/comment claiming enumerate_user_homes has no caller; two by-value returns copying a string
summary: Fixed in 74e4fbeb7.

trigger: Readers follow references to text that no longer exists (raised by docs-writer, consistency-auditor, plugin-developer, architect).
classification_rationale: dangling win.cpp pointer to the old macOS banner, a comment saying lstat never blocks, README wording (getmntinfo vs _r_np, timeout guidance, 10 s of output, auth_value_unreadable placement), Windows-landing checklist gaps, PR-relative test comments
summary: Fixed in 74e4fbeb7/251fe96e8.

trigger: getmntinfo fails while the sources are still read.
classification_rationale: mounts:getmntinfo_failed uses category '-' whose documented meaning is a whole source that could not be read
summary: Fixed in 74e4fbeb7: the token catalogue states category '-' with the sources still read.

trigger: Stale reference.
classification_rationale: the shared header's consumer list omitted this leg and the local macOS names
summary: Fixed in 74e4fbeb7.

caused_by: pass-1 fix 74e4fbeb7 (open-first restructure left the sidecar stat path-based)
trigger: The owner flips ~/Library between a directory and a symlink into an already-hung mount during the read; the pass-1 fix made the call post-open but did not remove the race.
classification_rationale: sidecar lstat after the open still resolves intermediate symlinks inside a 500 ms window
summary: Fixed in 251fe96e8: the parent directory is opened once (O_DIRECTORY|O_NOFOLLOW_ANY) and the database and sidecars are named relative to that descriptor (openat/fstatat AT_SYMLINK_NOFOLLOW); final delta re-reviewed clean.

trigger: Each contradicts the code or a sibling statement.
classification_rationale: caveat 3 said 'a macFUSE mount not in the deny-list' after macfuse was added; 'never writes' contradicted the temp-spill note; the darwin-compat row sentence read inverted; banner said time bounds start at the first query
summary: Fixed in 251fe96e8.

trigger: Mutants surviving.
classification_rationale: home_vanished and token_safe folding in enumerate_user_homes had no test
summary: Fixed in 251fe96e8 for the folding (delimiter-named home) and the null-array snapshot; home_vanished needs a fstatat seam and is a disclosed gap tracked in #5119.

trigger: A background fd opened during the count.
classification_rationale: the fd-count test had a theoretical flake window and nothing pinned charge() as non-noexcept
summary: Fixed in 251fe96e8: warm-up baseline; static_assert.

trigger: Comment welded onto the wrong function (also cross-platform G8-CP-1).
classification_rationale: the token_safe doc comment carried tcc_source_key's sentence and tcc_source_key lost its own
summary: Fixed in 251fe96e8.

trigger: Needs a root-created /Users entry.
classification_rationale: token_safe did not fold U+2028/2029 while sqlite_errmsg did
summary: Fixed in 251fe96e8.

trigger: A parent directory with mode x but no r and a 0644 database inside.
classification_rationale: opening the parent directory O_RDONLY needs read (not only search) permission where the old file open needed search only
summary: Rejected: fails closed and visibly as denied; real directories are root 0755 (/Library/...) or user 0700, so unreachable in practice.
